description: This file defines the external API for the Slap Object Container component in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the container object, but no actual implementation code.

methods.name: SlapCreateObjContainer
methods.description: Creates an object container with provided context handles.

methods.name: SlapOcoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Slap Object Container instance.

methods.name: SlapOcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Slap Object Container instance.

methods.name: SlapOcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols necessary objects within the container.
